{{Top}}
[[File:NabooRoyalStarship-SWE.png|thumb|250px|The J-type 327 Nubian royal starship was covered in chromium for decorative purposes.]]
'''Chromium''' was an element used in metallic objects, and could provide a mirror shine to the surface. Originally useful in blocking [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and certain forms of laser attacks, it came to represent nobility on such [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

The [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]], [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]], [[J-type star skiff]], and [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]] were fully covered in chromium. In Naboo culture, non-royal [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were forbidden from using chromium plating.<ref name="EP1VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> An exception to this was [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who continued to use fully plated ships even after stepping down as [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen of Naboo]] to represent her people in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|galactic senate]].

The royal [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], used to escort the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of Naboo dignitaries, wore partial chromium plating.

The [[Modirin Mining Concern]] was responsible for a large "chromium rush" on [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]] which turned out to be a scam involving mine-seeding.

The floating city [[Ipsus]], over [[Genarius]], was coated with chromium to protect against [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]].

[[Ladarra]] was considered a failed chromium mine.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
